name: The Haunting of Lunaris
source:
Eight mini-stories for you to sink your teeth into on this fine All Hallow's Eve. Isn't the aim of every great party to get home as quickly as possible? If so, you'll fit right in here in Lunaris!

[From [url=https://lunarisgames.itch.io/wtnc/devlog/192077/halloween-special]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这美好的万圣节前夜，尽情品味八则小故事。每场精彩派对的目标，不都是尽快回家吗？如果是，那你一定能融入卢纳里斯！

[摘自[url=https://lunarisgames.itch.io/wtnc/devlog/192077/halloween-special]itch.io[/url]]
